$comment: ADR-023 action-authorization matrix seed. Each entry maps an action name that a controller passes to ActionAuthService::requireAction() to the Nextcloud group IDs allowed to invoke it. Nextcloud admins always pass; ['admin'] or [] means admin-only, and an action missing from the matrix is admin-only too. The repair step InitializeActions copies this file into the JSON app-config value `actions` (app portaliq) on install and adds any seed action the stored value lacks on every upgrade, never changing an action already stored, so an admin's grants survive upgrades. To grant an action to a group, write the whole matrix back, e.g. `occ config:app:set portaliq actions --value='{"portal.author-news":["admin","communicatie"], ...}'`; read the current value first with `occ config:app:get portaliq actions`. Every new requireAction() call site needs an entry here, defaulting to ["admin"].
